resistance training is not a superior intervention model in comparison to an active control group, in the improvement of endothelial function and the reduction of inflammatory markers in elderly patients diagnosed with T2DM, in a short-term period.
resistance training did not improve endothelial function or inflammatory profile in elderly patients with TDM in a short‐ term period.
resistance training did not improve endothelial function and reduce inflammation in elderly patients with TDM.

the study of the influence of physical exercise in elderly people with diabetes mellitus.
the effects of a resistance training protocol on vascular and inflammatory outcomes.
the effect of a 12‐week strength training program in elderly patients with TDM.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
resistance training does not improve endothelial function or inflammation markers in T2DM elderly patients in a short‐period of intervention.
resistance training is not an effective intervention for the vascular and inflammatory outcomes of T2DM patients in the short‐term.
resistance training does not improve endothelial function and reduce inflammatory status in a short‐ term period in T2D elderly.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the short‐term effects of resistance training on endothelium and inflammatory markers are not superior to the control group, which may be explained by the short intervention period, and that further studies with a longer follow‐up period are required to evaluate these effects.
resistance training is not an adequate intervention for elderly patients with type two diabetes, in a short‐period of time.
resistance training is not an effective method for improving vascular function and inflammation markers, at least in the short‐term.
The main takeaway from our work is that
resistance training is not an effective intervention to improve both endothelial function and the inflammatory profile in a short-term period in T2D patients.
resistance training is not a sufficient intervention to improve both inflammatory and vascular outcomes in a short period in T2D patients.
the resistance exercise training is a safe and efficient intervention to improve the functional capacity of elderly patients with diabetes.
